comment: Flow 1 of the comparison: OrangeHRM's demo login driven by Jev end to end. The credentials are the ones the login page itself prints, so they are written plainly; the password still goes through secrets to exercise masking. The page is an empty shell before the single-page app renders, so setup waits for the Username field. text_in on the topbar breadcrumb, because 'Dashboard' also appears as a sidebar entry on every page after login.
goal: Log in with the given username and password so that the Dashboard opens: the topbar heading reads 'Dashboard' and the left sidebar lists 'PIM'.
notes: The Username and Password fields sit in the login card in the middle of the page; the Login button submits them. After a route change the app shows a spinner for a moment before the page renders: wait for the page to finish loading rather than acting on an empty page.

checks.login_form_shown: The login card shows a Username field, a Password field and a Login button
checks.sidebar_lists_pim: The left sidebar menu lists an entry named 'PIM'
checks.still_loading: A spinner or loading indicator is shown and the page content has not rendered yet

dashboard_open.when: The topbar heading reads 'Dashboard'. The left sidebar menu lists 'PIM'.

login_rejected.when: The login card shows the message 'Invalid credentials'.
login_rejected.note: the credentials are the ones the login page itself prints

field_required.when: A red 'Required' message is shown under the Username or the Password field after Login was clicked.
field_required.note: a value was not typed before Login was clicked

app_error.when: An error page or a message says something went wrong, an unexpected error occurred, or the service is unavailable.
